title: RLS Statement Vocabulary
description: Vocabulary for statements the group takes a stance on (Resonance module). It introduces no own data properties: the statement sentence lives in the base/v1 `title`, optional context in `description`. Its context defines the class `statement` (rls:Statement). Activation for the Resonance module follows from the class's declared affordance `votesOn` in the type manifest, not from carrying this vocabulary (spec 06, classes have IRIs).

title.description: The statement itself — one sentence (base/v1 term, required by this vocabulary).
